method: 60 fullscreen patches per level; targets sRGB primaries/D65, gamma 2.2. Each dataset normalized to its own mean white luminance, without chromatic adaptation. Gamma fit through normalized white using gray codes 32..224. No black subtraction. Generic CCSS, no repeatability confidence interval. Steps below 0.02 nit and measurements below 0.05 nit require caution; these are reporting thresholds, not a measured instrument specification.
